title: Expose revision metadata to editor saves
pr_body: The revisions API now returns both the opaque revision ID and ETag.
author: codex
provenance: Original synthetic production-style change authored for benchmark v2.

bugs.title: Save request sends object text instead of an ETag
bugs.rationale: loadRevision now returns an object. String(revision) serializes to [object Object], so If-Match never equals the document's ETag and normal saves fail with a conflict.
